exactToolArguments.prompt:
Create NEW ORIGINAL ASHVEIL Cinder Bear state animation art consistent with the attached OWN bear sources. This EXACT individual is a massive340kg quadruped bear: wide heavy shoulder hump with coarse ASH-GREY tipped mane across shoulders/back, dark charcoal/brown heavy layered fur, warm brown broad SHORT BEAR muzzle/face, small round ears, tiny rounded tail, four thick muscular bear legs and broad clawed paws. Match the same skull, head-to-body ratio, grey shoulder ridge and compact tail in all poses/directions. Not a wolf/dog, long pointed muzzle, giant white polar bear, lion, human, extra limb or generic new bear model. Fixed slightly elevated3/4 game camera, richly textured muted pixel-style original rendering.

ATLAS: exactly FOUR ROWS x FOUR COLUMNS = SIXTEEN distinct NEWLY DRAWN full-body source poses. Row1 DOWN/front toward viewer; row2 LEFT; row3 RIGHT; row4 UP/rear away from viewer. One row only one direction, no yaw/side turn to expose a face. The rear row NEVER shows an eye, nose, mouth or front face: only rear head/ears, shoulder/back, rump, tiny tail and correctly connected limbs. Left/right beak-like long dog noses forbidden; retain short bear muzzle. No per-frame zoom/new head shape. SAME scale and physical body proportions within the whole sheet. New poses, not renamed standing idle, mirrored cells or copied frames.

ANATOMY: exactly TWO forelimbs and TWO hindlimbs connected to correct shoulders/hips. Show believable thick shoulder->elbow->paw and hip->hock->paw paths. Far legs may be naturally partly occluded by fur/body; do not manufacture an extra middle paw to pretend they are visible. Short tail stays on rump, not used as a leg. Body must be heavy with real support, not floating or stuck through ground. Do not detach paws/limbs, add wounds/blood, exposed bones, clothing, equipment, prey, food, ground/soil/shadow pad, light/glow, text, symbols, labels, UI or motion trails. Transparent bear body ONLY.

SAFETY SPACING: every entire bear silhouette is fully included, including all paw/claw tips, ears and tail. At MOST55percent of each cell width and55percent cell height, huge true alpha-zero empty gutters between every body and neighbour or canvas edge. A wider resting bear must still fit whole with wide gaps. No clipping, silhouette overlap or neighbour fur in a rectangular crop. All16 closed complete bodies only on transparent PNG.

ACTION = HURT / brief four-legged impact reaction, NOT walking, attack, lying down or standing on two legs. For every row: column1 initial flinch, shoulders/head recoil a little away from impact while four-paw support begins shifting to hindquarters; column2 maximum short recoil/compression, fore elbows flex, heavy chest dips and neck tucks, hind paws planted; column3 weight settles forward again, front paws re-establish broad support without walking to a new tile; column4 recovered stable four-legged stance, head aligned to original facing. Four distinct anatomically plausible weight phases, short subdued facial flinch, no giant roar/teeth. Keep ground footprint nearly stable and no arbitrary new injury, limb amputation or baked hit flash. Rear shows only back of head and body weight change, not an invented backward-looking face.
